trailhead.label: The car park by the turn for Sant’Andrea, Giaglione, the board’s start

cautions: About 90 m along the SS25 at the start and end, and road crossings higher up: keep your dog on a short lead there.
A steady, fairly steep mule track (T2), rocky in places: watch your dog’s footing.
The lower part runs beside open vineyards: avoid hot afternoons and carry water for your dog.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Forte di Santa Chiara, Giaglione: Forte di Santa Chiara da Giaglione, andata e ritorno
textIt.The car park by the turn for Sant’Andrea: Il parcheggio vicino all’incrocio per Sant’Andrea, Giaglione, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.About 90 m along the SS25 at the start a: Circa 90 m lungo la SS25 all’inizio e alla fine, e attraversamenti di strada più in alto: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.A steady, fairly steep mule track (T2),: Una mulattiera costante e piuttosto ripida (T2), rocciosa in alcuni tratti: attenzione all’appoggio del cane.
textIt.The lower part runs beside open vineyard: La parte bassa costeggia vigneti aperti: evita i pomeriggi caldi e porta acqua per il cane.
